Hunting — навык с острова Galatea (центр: Hunting is a skill from the island of Galatea (its center is Tangleburg). You catch mobs and get their Shard. All shards go to the Hunting Box (/huntingbox).
Осколок «извлекают» (Syphon) — он прокач: A shard is syphoned and levels its attribute up to X. The attribute always works; you can turn it off in the attribute menu. The higher the rarity, the fewer shards are needed: Common 96, Uncommon 64, Rare 48, Epic 32, Legendary 24.
There are three types of shards: forest, water and combat. Forest ones are caught with the Lasso, water ones with a Fishing Net, combat ones with a Huntaxe + Black Hole. There are also traps, salts and fusion.
Опыт Hunting даётся за пойманный осколок: Hunting XP is given per caught shard ({0}–{1} by rarity), for fusion and syphoning. Each level gives +1 Hunter Fortune and a chance to "charm" a shard when killing any mob (Charming).

NPC стоят в Tangleburg на Galatea. Кажды: The NPCs are in Tangleburg on Galatea. Each gives a first tool and teaches one method.
Знакомит с Hunting, ведёт вехи и выдаёт: Introduces Hunting, tracks milestones and gives David's Cloak at the end of the tutorial.
Alan продаёт первый Huntaxe, Oden учит б: Alan sells the first Huntaxe, Oden teaches you to hit a mob down to 10% health, Albert gives the Small Pocket Black Hole, which "sucks in" the mob.
Даёт Basic Fishing Net. Сеть ловит водны: Gives the Basic Fishing Net. The net catches water creatures; damage depends on Pull.
Auryon (к югу от деревни): лесная охота: Auryon (south of the village): forest hunting
Даёт Abysmal Lasso. Брось на моба, держи: Gives the Abysmal Lasso. Throw it at a mob, keep looking at it and right-click when REEL appears.
Рядом с Fusion Machine. Объясняет, как и: Next to the Fusion Machine. Explains how to make a new shard from two. Later Kysha is available via Abiphone.
Сколько раз ты ловил осколки каждым спос: How many times you caught shards with each method, from the profile stats.
Бей моба Huntaxe (он не добивает), ниже: Hit the mob with a Huntaxe (it won't kill), place the Black Hole below 10% health. The Huntaxe takes up to 25% of the inserted weapon's stats.
Лови сетью водных существ. Часть ловится: Catch water creatures with a net. Some are caught at once, some have health; damage depends on Pull.
Брось лассо, смотри на моба, пока не кон: Throw the lasso, look at the mob until its stamina runs out, right-click on REEL. Some have several bars.
Поставь там, где водятся мобы с осколкам: Place it where shard mobs live: after ~24 hours it will hold a shard.
Съешь соль (ЛКМ) и убивай мобов как обыч: Eat a salt (left-click) and kill mobs as usual: a small chance to get their shard. Salt time doesn't run offline.
